topography.project_purpose: Dual-Token Stablecoin. Structurally: 140 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 12 ERC20 tokens, 10 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, poolconstant). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
